name: @pipeworx/mcp-datecalc

tools.name: date_diff
tools.description: Compute the difference between two dates/times (UTC). Returns the signed difference in ms, seconds, minutes, hours, days and weeks, plus a human-readable summary. Accepts ISO-8601 (e.g. "2026-01-01" or "2026-01-01T12:00:00Z").

tools.name: add_duration
tools.description: Add (or subtract, with negatives) a duration to a date and return the new UTC date/time. Provide any of years/months/weeks/days/hours/minutes/seconds.

tools.name: date_info
tools.description: Calendar facts about a date (UTC): weekday, day-of-year, ISO week number, quarter, whether the year is a leap year, and days in that month.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-datecalc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the datecalc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
